correctness.rationale: For Gaussian exposure directions, each of (n+1)! strict coordinate permutations has equal probability. For m=1 a winner pattern is a subset of leaves above the hub, of size k, with k!(n-k)! orders; for every m>=2 the triple-simplex winners recover the decreasing ORDERED high-leaf list, with (n-k)! orders. This yields exact Z_{n,1}=(n+1)^(-q) sum C(n,k)^(1-q) and Z_{n,m}=n!/((n+1)!)^q sum(j!)^(q-1), m>=2. Independent permutations check all n=2..5 and all m. Uniform Stirling plus Riemann sums at q=1+t/n and 1+t/(n log n) give the stated h(x) and uniform-x crossover integrals; Shannon limits 1/2 by direct differentiation. Fixed-q and collision limits follow from binomial/factorial dominance. These are genuine analytical asymptotics rather than finite extrapolation, and exclude anisotropic Gaussian metrics.
